subject: 🔧 [$priority] New maintenance request #$request_id - $building_name Room $room_number
body:
Hello $admin_name,

A new housing maintenance request has been submitted and needs triage.

=== REQUEST ===
Request ID: $request_id
Priority: $priority
Issue Type: $issue_type
Status: $status
Submitted On: $request_date
Submitted By: $submitted_by

=== LOCATION ===
Building: $building_name
Room Number: $room_number
Floor Number: $floor_number
Room Type: $room_type

=== RESIDENT ===
Name: $student_name
Student ID: $student_id
Email: $student_email

=== DESCRIPTION ===
$description

=== TARGET RESPONSE TIME ===
$response_target

=== NEXT STEPS ===
1. Review the request in Housing → Maintenance Requests.
2. Assign it to a technician and set a scheduled date.
3. The resident has already been sent an acknowledgement.

This is an automated message from the University Housing Management System.

$signature

response_target.default: Per the standard priority response times.
